title: Melting Pumpkin Moon
description: A surreal painting shows a large melting orange pumpkin with a sad face and yellow eyes, positioned next to a glowing black crescent moon. Smaller melting pumpkins and colorful hanging lanterns with geometric patterns float around them against a purple and orange gradient sky, with vibrant paint splatters and dripping textures throughout.
prompt: Surreal scene of a large sad melting orange pumpkin with droopy yellow eyes next to a glowing black and white crescent moon. Smaller melting pumpkins float nearby. Colorful geometric hanging lanterns with intricate patterns dangle from above. Vibrant red, blue and teal paint splatters and drips cover the composition. Gradient purple to orange sky background, whimsical and slightly eerie atmosphere, painterly style with visible brushstrokes and liquid textures.
medium: digital painting with watercolor splatter effects
